sections.label: New UI
items: Fully redesigned interface — cleaner layout, smoother navigation, and a more intuitive project experience
New agent build UI — live progress timeline shows exactly what the agent is doing step by step as it builds your app
Credit price estimation shown upfront before you confirm any action — no surprises

sections.label: New Features
items: Project Briefing — every project now has a living document the agent keeps updated, so it always remembers your app's full context, screens, and logic across sessions
File Bucket — each project gets its own private file storage for images, videos, and assets your app can upload and serve
Wallet — built-in TON wallet lets you top up credits, hold TON balance, and manage transactions without leaving the app
Token Swaps & App Stocks — buy and sell your app's token directly in the Wallet via the integrated swap interface
App Store — publish your app with a listing, screenshots, and description so others can discover and use it
Image Generation — generate AI images and use them directly as assets inside your app
Agent Vision — attach screenshots or mockups and the agent understands them visually when building or updating
Draw Mockups — sketch a rough layout and the agent uses your drawing as a blueprint
Pro Mode — higher quality build mode with deeper reasoning for complex apps
Free Agent Asks — clarifying questions the agent asks before building are completely free

sections.label: Security & Control
items: Improved app security — user code runs in a sandboxed environment; platform secrets are no longer accessible to project code
Unlink Bot — you can now safely unlink your Telegram bot from a project at any time from the project settings
Bot token is encrypted at rest and never exposed to your app's backend code

sections.label: Performance
items: Up to 1.5x faster builds — agent pipeline optimised to reduce iteration time
Up to 2x quality improvement — smarter planning and self-review pass before publishing
Questions UI — agent asks one focused question at a time with tap-to-answer buttons instead of text walls

title: Agent Update — Smarter, Cleaner, More Reliable

sections.label: Build Quality
items: Fixed: black screen on freshly created apps
Fixed: updates that broke working apps or changed things you didn't ask for
Fixed: random errors leaking into chat messages
Fixed: app.js / styles.css sometimes missing from index.html
Agent now properly includes the Telegram Mini App SDK for Game apps
Stronger pre-flight checks catch API URL bugs, broken quotes, and missing files before the build reaches you — far fewer broken apps get published

sections.label: Smarter Plans & Updates
items: Plans now stream live as the agent writes them — Build / Edit buttons appear when the plan is ready
Updates incrementally append diffs to your project's memory, then compact it every 5 iterations — faster, cheaper, and more accurate over time
Ask mode upgraded: it can now read your project files, run database queries, and reference Apps Father's own feature docs

sections.label: Polish & Fixes
items: "Run & Test" hidden for Text Bot apps — only Release shows (Run & Test never made sense for bots anyway)
Bot description no longer copies your raw prompt
Touch + mouse parity enforced — no more buttons that respond on phone but ignore desktop clicks
Z-index discipline applied across overlays and modals — invisible buttons trapped under panels are gone

sections.label: New Tools
items: Dedicated in-app player for previewing your build with a proper Apps Father splash
Visual editor — tweak styles directly inside the live preview without touching code
Comfortable bug reporter — capture and send issues straight from any app you build
